title: Cross-day 待記帳 queue (edit any unrecorded txn, not just per-day)
description:
## Context
The edit-on-web feature (OpenSpec `edit-transactions-on-web`, deployed) lets you edit 類別 / 收支別 / TAG and tick 已記帳 inline, per day, by clicking a day in the spend heatmap.

## Limitation to solve
The heatmap only makes days WITH spend clickable. A day with only income or transfers (no 支出) is unreachable, so those transactions can't be edited/recorded from the web.

## Proposal
Add a single cross-day「全部待記帳」view listing every un-recorded transaction (any type, any date, newest first), reusing the same inline edit + 已記帳 UX (`editRow` / `updateTxn`). Recording removes it from the queue; a show-recorded toggle reveals done rows.

## Notes
- Pure frontend + existing `updateTxn` backend; no schema change.
- Deploy to the live deployment `AKfycbyv…` (not the stale `AKfycbyK…`).
- Acceptance: an income-only / transfer-only day's transactions are reachable and editable.

title: Verify web edit-back writes to the Sheet on real data
description:
Acceptance for OpenSpec `edit-transactions-on-web` (deployed @20).

On the live dashboard (`AKfycbyv…`), analysis tab → single month → click a day:
- Change a transaction's 類別 → confirm column K updates for that row in the Sheet.
- Change 收支別 → column J updates.
- Mark 已記帳 → the row leaves the queue and column A ticks.
- Toggle 顯示已記帳 → recorded rows appear with 取消記帳.

Report the observed result (not just "done").

title: Finalize bot→bound merge: retire the standalone Apps Script project
description:
Follow-up to OpenSpec `merge-bot-into-bound-project` (cutover done; the bound project runs the bot on a trigger).

After the bound auto-record has run stably for a cycle or two:
- Delete the standalone Apps Script project (scriptId `18WyCJz…`) in the UI.
- Remove the repo's root `cards_transaction_bot.js` and root `.clasp.json` so only the `sidebar/` clasp config remains.
- Optional: swap `openById(SPREADSHEET_ID)` → `getActiveSpreadsheet()` once the bound container is confirmed to be the same sheet.
- Archive the OpenSpec change.

title: Clean up stale Web App deployments
description:
The bound dashboard project has several deployments. Keep only the one the user actually uses:
- KEEP `AKfycbyvVvKPI…` (the live URL; menu + bookmark point here).
- Retire the stale ones: `AKfycbyKqTW…` (updated by mistake across @14–@17) and the old category-view deployments (@6–@9).

Goal: one canonical deployment so a deploy always reaches the user's URL.

title: Decide: remove the 本月預估 projstrip from the dashboard
description: The 類別 tab still shows a 本月預估 (month-end projection) strip from the original build. The user said month-end projection isn't needed. Decide whether to remove it; if yes, drop the projstrip block in `categoryTab()` and its CSS, then redeploy to `AKfycbyv…`.
